latest.title: Marketing: the cheapest campaigns for 100% promotion, set in one click
latest.summary: Every shop and office page now shows the cheapest set of marketing campaigns that brings its promotion to 100%, or its marketing to 100% where the street's foot traffic can't get it there, with the cost per day before and after. With the Big Copilot Link mod 0.4.0 one click books it in the game, for one site or all of them at once, and adds a switch for every campaign type to the business's BizMan Marketing page, so no phone call or chat with the agency is needed. Campaigns a business already has switch on or off at any time; a new campaign type is added through a marketing agency already in your phone's contacts while it is open, and the board says when an agency opens or which one to visit first. The overview lists the sites that could reach more promotion or pay less for it. Undo puts the campaigns back as they were.
